1.title: Ashley Kramer ElevenLabs w  Sophia Dew
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Voice agents moving from pilots to production; case studies from Clover Health (Medicare), KPN (telecom verification), Deutsche Telekom (translation). Covers enterprise blockers, adoption timeline, and why voice preference matters.

1.title: Rethinking Claude Code Best Practices — Lydia Hallie, Anthropic
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Lydia Hallie (Anthropic, Claude Code dev relations) walks through what changed in best practices between older Claude models and 5.5 — what to keep, what's now overhead, what's newly possible. Assumes you're already using Claude Code.

2.title: How You Deliver Words Matters More Than What AI Says | Alex Holt
2.author: MTS
2.hook: ElevenLabs Field CTO walks through new Interaction Engine, agent orchestration tools, and NVIDIA partnership; positions voice delivery as the enterprise bottleneck and forecasts voice agents replacing IVR by end of 2026.

3.title: How To Make More Money Than You Deserve (My 2027 Framework)
3.author: Alex Hormozi
3.hook: Hormozi's personal wealth-building framework; portfolio structure, equity vs. salary arbitrage, and scaling mechanics across 10 companies doing $250M/yr.

4.title: ПРОФЕССИЯ: РЕЖИССËР
4.author: РЕЖУПРАВЛЕНИЕ Жоры Крыжовникова
4.hook: Russian film directors discuss career paths, creative choices, and working with actors — no AI, product, or platform mechanism content.

1.title: China Is Ahead on World Models for Robots | Anastasis Germanidis
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Runway's CEO discusses Praxis-1 (open-sourced world action model), why video pre-training transfers to robot control, production timelines for generalist robots, and the US-China race on physical AI. Tops NVIDIA's RoboLab 120 benchmark.

2.title: How To Become Disgustingly Financially Literate
2.author: Sandeep Swadia
2.hook: Personal wealth management framework (Freedom/Resilience/Ego/Enough) covering time-buying, market recovery, investment psychology, and defining sufficiency.

1.title: Why Frontier AI Labs Could Go Bankrupt | Ege Erdil
1.author: MTS
1.hook: DeepMind engineer argues frontier AI labs are capital-intensive low-margin businesses (like airlines, not software monopolies), questions 2027 intelligence explosion timelines, estimates 20-year horizon for white-collar automation.
